description: This source file defines an enum 'OpenClawKitResources' that manages resource bundle locations for the OpenClawKit project, including locating the appropriate bundle in various environments (packaged app, SwiftPM development, etc.). It contains methods to locate and fall back to different bundle locations to prevent crashes if resources are missing or not where expected.

classes.name: BundleLocator
classes.description: A helper class used solely for obtaining a reference to a Bundle based on its class context, aiding in locating the resource bundle.

methods.name: locateBundle
methods.description: Main method to determine and return the appropriate resource Bundle for OpenClawKit by checking several locations.

methods.name: loadModuleBundleSafely
methods.description: Attempts to locate the module bundle using heuristic search around common directory structures to avoid crashing with Bundle.module.
